rounds.gap: desktop: Row contents sit low in the loser. The pink calendar glyphs hang about 2-3px below their labels: the icon top is flush with the cap line and its bottom falls about 6px under the baseline. The 'in 3 days' label also sits low in the 35px blue selection pill, with about 12px above the caps and about 7px below the baseline. The winner centres both: its about 23px icons overhang the text evenly (about 4px above, about 3px below), and its label has about 10/9px inside the pill. It also uses the same 11px gap between the field and the list as its side margins, where the loser uses 9px. Fix: nudge the icons up about 2px and centre the label in the highlight.  /  The selected 'in 3 days' label sits low inside its blue pill. The loser's highlight spans about y61-97 with the cap top at 74 and the baseline at 89, which leaves about 12px above the text and 7px below. Its first-row text also breaks the 38px row rhythm by 1px. The winner's pill spans about y63-99 around the same 16px cap block, leaving 9.5px above and below, and its 10px gap below the search field matches the 38px row pitch. Move the loser's pill down 2px, or centre it on the row's line box. Also stop fading the calendar icon to a washed-out lavender on the selected row: keep the pink header bar solid, as the winner does.  ·  phone: The 'This Evening' moon hangs low in the loser. Its 28px glyph ends about 6px below the text baseline but starts only about 3px above the cap line, so it looks dropped against the label. The winner centres the moon on the cap height (about 4px over, about 3px under), matching how the star sits next to 'Today'. The loser's calendar rows are also spaced unevenly (61/63/61px), where the winner keeps a steady 62px rhythm. Fix: raise the moon about 2-3px and snap the grid rows to one pitch.  /  The 'This Evening' moon hangs about 3px low. In the loser it spans about y166-193 against a cap block of y168-186, with 2px above the cap top and 7px below the baseline, so it sags under the text. The winner's moon spans y163-190, with about 5px above and 4px below, centred on the cap height like the star next to 'Today'. The loser's calendar grid also steps 61/63/61px between rows where the winner holds an even 62/62/62, and the stacked 'Jun 1' sits 1.5px low in its row. Nudge the moon up 3px and snap the grid rows to one integer pitch.  /  The This Evening moon glyph (~24x25px) sits about 3px low: its centre is at y~180 against the text's cap-height midline at ~177, so its bottom hangs below the baseline. The winner centres a ~22x25px moon on the midline, the same way the star centres on Today. Nudge it up 3px or centre it on cap height.
